review.central_scientific_object: The serving-induced observation kernel of a persistent skill updater: the mapping from a generated search object T_K to the updater-visible evidence g(T_K), where the acting selector a(T_K) and the learning projection g(T_K) are distinct and the default coupling g=a=winner-only endogenously censors diagnostic failures.
claims_to_delete: CADP as a novel method: success/failure pairing, first-divergence extraction, contrastive skill editing, and replay validation are all already in SkillCAT; delete CADP-specific novelty claims and demote to optional baseline unless it beats Rejected-Witness under matched budgets.
Any claim that failure feedback is useful for skill evolution: already established by Rethinking Self-Evolving Agent Skills.
Any claim that outcome-based filtering discards useful branch structure: already established by TopoCurate.
Any claim that search experience can be recycled into training: already established by Do Not Waste Your Rollouts, TSR, and Expert Iteration.

Any claim that sibling contrast or first-divergence extraction is novel: already established by Search-E1, Sibling-Guided Credit Distillation, Outcome-Verified Comparative Self-Distillation, and SKILL-KD.
Any claim that bounded validation-gated skill editing or rejected-edit memory is novel: already established by SkillOpt and SkillHEX.

The information-theoretic statement I(Z; g_win(T_K)) <= I(Z; T_K) as a scientific contribution: it is a vacuous data-processing inequality for a fixed LLM updater and should be removed or explicitly labeled as non-contributing intuition.

The i.i.d. Bernoulli intermediate-difficulty peak p*(K) as an empirical law: it is an elementary order-statistic calculation under a one-parameter model and should be presented only as a reference curve, not a theorem about natural task distributions.

The continuous-verifier layer-cake identity as a substantive extension: it is a standard layer-cake representation that adds no empirical content beyond the binary case unless a threshold policy is actually used.

The Gamma-times-delta factorization as a theoretical result: it is a tautological decomposition whose scientific content is entirely in whether delta_z is positive and predictable, which is an empirical claim about the updater.
review.decisive_intervention: The cloned-state exact-same-pool projection-null experiment: take one fixed pre-update skill state, one task batch, one exact K-pool, one acting winner, one updater, one verifier, and one update seed; clone the skill state into arms differing only in g(T_K) (winner-only vs. precommitted rejected witness vs. contrast packet); freeze all skills and evaluate on a common held-out K=1 probe. If changing g(T_K) produces no directional difference in future frozen skill in the predicted direction, the central mechanism is dead.
review.explicit_stop_condition: STOP if the cloned-state exact-same-pool projection-null experiment shows no directional effect of changing g(T_K) on future frozen skill, or if a source-faithful SkillCAT-style contrast baseline run on the same pools and updater reproduces the full effect without the serving-selection causal chain, or if the prospective Gamma-times-delta prediction fails to predict held-out family sign and rank ordering.
review.mechanism_derived_method: Rejected-Witness projection: keep the acting winner fixed, but when the pool contains a mixed rescue event, feed the updater a single precommitted nonserved failure witness from the same pool instead of the served winner; no extra actor rollouts, no contrast packet, no bounded editing beyond the existing updater. This is the minimal intervention that directly tests whether the censored failure evidence, not contrastive structure or token budget, drives the learning effect.
review.recommendation: REVISE_AND_NARROW_TO_SINGLE_OBJECT. The paper must be reframed as a mechanism-level causal study of serving-induced selective trajectory logging in persistent self-evolution, with the exact rescue-censoring identity as a definitional tool, not a theorem. The only method that follows naturally from the mechanism is Rejected-Witness; CADP should be demoted to an optional ablation unless it beats Rejected-Witness under matched budgets. The decisive cloned-state projection-null experiment must pass before any longitudinal or prospective claims are made. The paper must freeze a mutually exclusive failure-family partition and precommit the rejected-witness rule before outcomes. SkillCAT and TopoCurate must be mandatory baselines and closest-work discussions. If SkillCAT-style contrast explains the full effect without the serving-selection causal chain, the paper should be reduced to an application or stopped.
review.single_causal_chain: Best-of-K acting selection over a shared search pool improves current reward by rescuing tasks where the precommitted rollout fails and another succeeds; the same selection, when bound to the learning projection, removes exactly those rescued failures from the updater's visible experience; if the censored failure carries positive reusable diagnostic value for a persistent skill, the updater's future frozen-skill quality degrades even as online acting improves.
review.single_sentence_verdict: R17 survives only as a narrow mechanism-level claim that serving-time winner selection endogenously censors diagnostic failures from a persistent updater, testable through a single cloned-state projection-null experiment and a prospective Gamma-times-delta prediction, with Rejected-Witness as the minimal method and SkillCAT as the mandatory reduction baseline.
review.strongest_theoretical_prediction: For a precommitted disjoint failure-family partition Z, the one-step cloned-state projection effect on future frozen skill equals the sum over families of the rescue-censoring mass times the family-specific diagnostic advantage, and this quantity predicts the sign and rank ordering of held-out family-level frozen-skill deficits prospectively, with the largest deficits occurring in intermediate-solvability families where the rescue-censoring mass is maximal.
